newsitem.title: USA: Tellabs gets contract for Belgium GSM.
newsitem.headline: Tellabs gets contract for Belgium GSM.

text.p: Tellabs Inc said Thursday it won a contract to supply its MartisDXX managed access and transport network to Mobistar for its GSM (global system for mobile communications) system in Belgium.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
Mobistar, a collaboration between Telinfo NV and France Telecom Mobiles International, launched its GSM network in the third quarter of 1996.

The Martis system is being deployed to increase network capacity and enable network testing and line-quality monitoring, Mobistar said. It said it intends to deploy addition MartisDXX nodes in the future.
